_readme: Copy to panel_setup/livecams.json (git-ignored). Only use streams you are permitted to use on a display like this one: your own IP cameras, webcams published under an open licence, or a provider's feed where its terms allow. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

cams.name: Crossing
cams._url: HLS .m3u8, MJPEG http(s) stream, rtsp://user:pass@host/stream, a local video file (looped), or an image URL (polled every 'poll' seconds, default 3).
cams.label: Crossing, Tokyo
cams._focus: x, y: focus point as a fraction of the frame; zoom 1 = full frame height cropped to the portrait wall, 2 = twice as close.
cams._pan: slow drift left and right across the frame.
cams._led: true: ordered dither against the 6-bit LED banding.
